vehicles.name: Hawk Dash
vehicles.summary: R123's Hawk Dash: a bubbly Aussie V8 sedan in the spirit of the Falcon XR8 Sprint. Long bonnet with a power bulge and two vents, a gaping hexagonal grille under swept narrow lamps, vertical lamp slots in the bumper corners, wide wrap-around tail lamps, quad exhausts, a ducktail lip, twin stripes nose to tail and a side 'C' stripe. Code-built from a generated reference sheet (R81). Rear drive, 1700 kg: the Lion President's spec twin.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

vehicles.name: Lion President
vehicles.summary: R123's Lion President: a bubbly Aussie V8 sedan in the spirit of the last V8 Commodore, the SS-V Redline. Gloss-black roof, two big forward-facing bonnet nostrils, angular lamps with LED fangs, a wide lower grille split by one thick bar, slatted air curtains, side skirts, a tall wing on posts, a full-width tail lamp on a black band, a black diffuser with quad exhausts, red calipers and a black-and-gold shoulder pinstripe. Code-built from a generated reference sheet (R81). Rear drive, 1700 kg: the Hawk Dash's spec twin.

vehicles.name: Cruz Missile
vehicles.summary: The Playtest-1 car: a Holden Cruze-based rally sedan code-built from the owner's reference sheets (R81). Front drive, 1200 kg (R136: the Cruze is front-driven).

vehicles.name: Tradie Ute
vehicles.summary: The owner's dual-cab Mitsubishi Triton as a roster car (R123): tray, TJM-style bull bar, snorkel on the driver's A-pillar, roof rack, hi-vis tradie livery. Code-built from the Triton build script's proportions. Rear drive, 1900 kg: heavier and torquier than the Cruz, lower top speed.
